description: This is a test class for the UserValidator component in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests that validate the behavior and constraints of user data validation logic.

classes.name: UserValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the validation logic of UserValidator in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithOnlyAlphaNumerics
methods.description: Tests that usernames with only alphanumeric characters are considered valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithAlphaDashAndUnderscore
methods.description: Tests that usernames with dash, underscore, and dot characters are valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithAlphaDashUnderscoreAndDot
methods.description: Similar to above, tests that usernames with specific special characters are recognized as valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithExactlyMaxSizeName
methods.description: Ensures usernames exactly at the maximum length are valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateUsernameWithLessThanMinimumLength
methods.description: Checks that usernames shorter than the minimum length are invalid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateUsernameWithInvalidCharacter
methods.description: Tests that usernames containing invalid characters are rejected.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateUsernameWithMoreThanMaximumSize
methods.description: Checks that usernames exceeding maximum allowed length are invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsNull
methods.description: Verifies validation fails when a retired user has no retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies validation fails when a retired user has an empty retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsWhitespace
methods.description: Verifies validation fails when a retired user has a whitespace-only retire reason.

methods.name: invokeValidateAndAssertHasErrorRetireReason
methods.description: Helper method to assert validation errors regarding retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Checks that a properly filled user object passes validation.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateWhenUsernameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that null username is considered valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateWhenUsernameIsTheEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that an empty username string is considered valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateWhenUsernameIsWhitespaceOnly
methods.description: Ensures whitespace-only usernames are invalid.

methods.name: isUserNameAsEmailValid_shouldReturnFalseIfEmailInvalid
methods.description: Tests various invalid email formats for username-as-email validation.

methods.name: isUserNameAsEmailValid_shouldReturnTrueIfEmailValid
methods.description: Tests valid email formats for username-as-email validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailAsUsernameEnabledAndEmailInvalid
methods.description: Checks validation behavior when email-as-username property is enabled and email is invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailAsUsernameDisabledAndEmailProvided
methods.description: Checks validation when email-as-username is disabled but email is provided on user.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotThrowNPEWhenUserIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation handles null user objects gracefully.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that user fields within length limits pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Verifies validation fails when user fields exceed maximum lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailIsInvalid
methods.description: Checks that invalid email formats fail validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfEmailIsValid
methods.description: Checks that valid email formats pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailIsNotUnique
methods.description: Verifies validation catches duplicate email addresses.
